name: Chamber
description: Small classical ensemble, one player to a part: a string quartet joined by piano. Intimacy is the point — thin texture, transparent layering, every line audible. Budget: at most 5 concurrent layers, energy clamp [0.20, 0.70]; the ceiling is a hard constraint, the floor is a soft directive. Octave doubling is reserved for louder passages (energy above 0.55), and the piano answers in the rests of the strings rather than playing continuously. Every role is a track the app already has — picking this band only decides who is on stage.
